text:
FinLedger Admin: We're locked out of the console and models after the RBAC changes rolled earlier. billing page 403, model endpoints return PERMISSION_DENIED. Urgent, this is blocking production.

Raj Patel: Sorry — can you paste org id and a screenshot of the 403? Which region?

FinLedger Admin: org_89231, us-east-1. Screenshot attached (can't paste here). Happening for multiple users in our org.

Raj Patel: Thanks. Escalating to security + infra. @Alice @John — looks like many 'viewer' roles lost model permissions after the refactor. Can you take a look?

Alice Chen: I'm on it. I see the deploy logs: rbac-refactor-v2 rolled at 11:03 UTC by deploy-bot. Quick grep of the role-mapping shows billing-viewer group got a tighter policy.

Alice Chen: Audit snippet:
```
2026-03-12T11:03:12Z deploy-bot rbac-refactor-v2 applied
resource=roles/billing-viewer old_perms=[billing:read, projects:list, models:inspect] new_perms=[billing:read, projects:list]
```
Alice Chen: Looks like models:inspect (and transitively models:invoke for console flows) was dropped. That explains model list + run failures.

John Li: Confirmed — role-mapping migration script defaulted to strict set. This was a policy regression.

Maya Gomez: Can we patch this quickly for FinLedger? They are in prod.

Alice Chen: Two options: 1) Patch org level role to re-add models:inspect+models:invoke for finledger, or 2) rollback rbac-refactor-v2. I'll prefer targeted patch to minimize blast radius.

Raj Patel: Customer asked for ETA on restore. Can we do targeted patch now?

John Li: I'll grant temporary role via infra CLI. Command:
```
infractl roles grant --org org_89231 --role support-temp --perms "models:inspect,models:invoke,billing:read" --expires-in 1h
```
deploy-bot: Applied role grant to org_89231 (support-temp).

support-bot: Action logged: ticket#5432, run_by=Raj, activity=grant_temp_role, expires=2026-03-12T12:04:21Z.

FinLedger Admin: Confirmed — users can see models and billing now. Access restored, thanks.

Alice Chen: I'll push a permanent fix to the role-mapping repo. Proposed change: add models:inspect to billing-viewer and ensure migration test covers transitive perms. Patch diff: 
```
- "billing-viewer": ["billing:read","projects:list"]
+ "billing-viewer": ["billing:read","projects:list","models:inspect"]
```
Alice Chen: Also flagging for security review: we dropped perms without test coverage. Opening SR ticket.

Maya Gomez: I'll send FinLedger a post-mortem and confirm they don't need further support.

John Li: Scheduling a rollback window in case we see side effects, but targeted patch should be fine.

Alice Chen: Audit log entries for the grant and original deploy attached for compliance: 
```
2026-03-12T11:03:12Z deploy-bot apply rbac-refactor-v2
2026-03-12T11:45:02Z infractl grant support-temp org_89231 by JohnLi
```
Raj Patel: Closing loop: FinLedger access restored at 11:46 UTC. Follow-ups: add unit tests, add an e2e check verifying model list+invoke for viewer roles, and create SOC ticket for audit review.

FinLedger Admin: Appreciate the fast response. Please share the post-mortem when ready. :thumbsup: 

Alice Chen: Will do. Marking this resolved for support ticket#5432. :white_check_mark:
